title: Dead vertices of a circuit
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n$ input vertices, gates in topological order, and a designated output vertex. Its dead-vertex list consists of the vertices $v$ with $0 \le v < n + \mathrm{length}(C.\mathrm{gates})$ that are not the output and are read by no gate.
